description: The MEASURED ranked list of trade setups of every kind — arbitrage venue pairs, event cards by thesis side, fund tokens, single vehicles, theme baskets — for the user's amount, target and horizon, net of round-trip costs. Every row: risk_tier 1-5 (risk_label; the worst measured move of the setup itself), net probable return and its lower bound, p_target (share of measured moves that covered the target), the size for a 1% risk budget, and the TIME-TO-TARGET — measured first passage for series-backed rows (ttt_share of start days that got there, ttt_median_days, ttt_fastest_days) or the compounding count (ttt_steps) for arbitrage and cards. `fastest` names the most repeatable measured path to the target (share of start days that got there, then median days), or says none got there. order = risk (lowest risk first), time (fastest first) or rank (risk-budgeted lower bound). Use these numbers when asked for setups, a risk ranking, how long a target takes, or which vehicles to combine — never a free-hand list. Read-only; past measurements, never a forecast or a promise. (no key needed)
